concepts.gloss_en: Length of days / longevity (drawn down via fear of Heaven and Torah study; aspect of elder / tikkunei Atik)

reason_for_human: Both forms are the identical construct phrase 'length of days'; אריכות הימים simply carries a definite article on the nomen rectum, which is inflectional variation of the same word, not a homograph or archetype/generic split. All 9 occurrences sit in the same conceptual chain (fear → longevity → elder/Atik → wealth), mostly within lesson 60, and every context means the same 'length of days.' Safe single concept.
